steps.objective: 完成「一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳」的獨立重算基準，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete independently recalculate the baseline for 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
本階段計算任務：閱讀來源 O-RAN public specifications，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：控制動作使用的狀態年齡包含採樣、傳送、決策及施作延遲；高頻輸出不代表輸入新鮮。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：取樣年齡20 ms、傳送10、決策15、施作5；第二組傳送增至50，其他不變。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
依此處給定的條件手算量綱及數值，再以獨立試算欄重算。先辨認本階段使用的是名義輸入、變更後輸入或驗收殘差，不要直接抄用原答案。判準：輸入表應能唯一重建式 20+10+15+5 與 20+50+15+5，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 O-RAN ALLIANCE 的規格。
名義模型參考（輸入改變時須重新代入）：第一組：20+10+15+5 = 50 ms；第二組：20+50+15+5 = 90 ms。每個數值先標單位，先算括號與線性量，最後才換dB或百分比。
steps.instructionEn:
Investigation calculation: Read O-RAN public specifications to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: State age at actuation includes sampling, transport, decision and actuation delay; frequent outputs do not guarantee fresh inputs. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Use sample age20 ms, transport10, decision15 and actuation5; increase transport to50 in the changed case. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
Calculate with the conditions specified here, checking dimensions and repeating independently in a worksheet. Identify whether this investigation uses nominal inputs, changed inputs, or acceptance residuals; do not copy the baseline answer. Criterion: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 20+10+15+5 and 20+50+15+5 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to O-RAN ALLIANCE.
Baseline model reference (substitute again when inputs change): Baseline: 20+10+15+5 = 50 ms; changed case: 20+50+15+5 = 90 ms. Annotate units before evaluating parentheses and linear quantities; convert to dB or percentages only at the stated step.
steps.observation: 兩種重算的差異有量綱與捨入說明。第一組：20+10+15+5 = 50 ms；第二組：20+50+15+5 = 90 ms。每個數值先標單位，先算括號與線性量，最後才換dB或百分比。
steps.observationEn: The independent calculations reconcile with units and rounding accounted for. Baseline: 20+10+15+5 = 50 ms; changed case: 20+50+15+5 = 90 ms. Annotate units before evaluating parentheses and linear quantities; convert to dB or percentages only at the stated step.
steps.failure: 只複製同一公式兩次，未形成獨立核對；捨入掩蓋門檻差異。
steps.failureEn: Copying one formula twice instead of cross-checking independently, or rounding away a threshold difference.
steps.check: 輸入表應能唯一重建式 20+10+15+5 與 20+50+15+5，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 O-RAN ALLIANCE 的規格。
steps.checkEn: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 20+10+15+5 and 20+50+15+5 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to O-RAN ALLIANCE.

steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。振盪可能來自遙測延遲或控制增益過大；先固定增益重播相同序列，只改時間戳延遲。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Oscillation may come from telemetry delay or excessive gain; replay the same sequence at fixed gain and vary delay only.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 輸入表應能唯一重建式 20+10+15+5 與 20+50+15+5，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 O-RAN ALLIANCE 的規格。

steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
ric_event_trace.csv, state-age histogram and fallback decisions. All numbers, budgets and thresholds are synthetic educational assumptions, not system specifications or service guarantees. Use offline calculation or simulation without operating a transmitter.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 20+10+15+5 and 20+50+15+5 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to O-RAN ALLIANCE.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 O-RAN public specifications，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：控制動作使用的狀態年齡包含採樣、傳送、決策及施作延遲；高頻輸出不代表輸入新鮮。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：取樣年齡20 ms、傳送10、決策15、施作5；第二組傳送增至50，其他不變。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read O-RAN public specifications to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: State age at actuation includes sampling, transport, decision and actuation delay; frequent outputs do not guarantee fresh inputs. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Use sample age20 ms, transport10, decision15 and actuation5; increase transport to50 in the changed case. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
